entries.name: Border Raid
entries.summary: A raiding force crosses the frontier before the court agrees whether it is an invasion.

entries.name: Wells Run Foul
entries.summary: The water tastes of soil, fever, and administrative neglect.

entries.name: Grain Panic
entries.summary: Rumors of empty granaries spread faster than hunger itself.

entries.name: Street Preachers
entries.summary: Unauthorized sermons turn despair into either discipline or revolt.

entries.name: Festival Turns Riot
entries.summary: A celebration spills into the streets, and joy becomes demand.

entries.name: Guild Strike
entries.summary: The workshops fall silent, and everyone remembers who maintains the Empire.

entries.name: Foreign Complaint
entries.summary: A neighboring court demands apology, tribute, or proof of seriousness.

entries.name: Scribal Error
entries.summary: A mistaken decree exposes how much of the Empire depends on copying things correctly.

entries.name: Veterans Demand Pay
entries.summary: Old soldiers arrive with scars, witnesses, and unpaid promises.

entries.name: Market Fire
entries.summary: A district burns; the question is whether institutions contain the panic.

entries.name: Plague Season
entries.summary: Fever moves faster than messengers.

entries.name: Court Schism
entries.summary: The court splits into factions, each claiming to preserve the Empire from the others.

entries.name: Heresy Accusations
entries.summary: Priests, scholars, and crowds disagree on which truths are dangerous.

entries.name: Mine Collapse
entries.summary: Stone and timber fail; the court asks whether this is tragedy or negligence.

entries.name: Militia Desertions
entries.summary: Hungry soldiers begin to wonder why they defend an Empire that cannot feed them.

entries.name: Bread and Circuses
entries.summary: The people can still be entertained, but entertainment is not governance.

entries.name: Failed Experiment
entries.summary: The workshop burns, but some insist the notes survived.

entries.name: Border Ultimatum
entries.summary: A rival power demands tribute, apology, or blood.

entries.name: Contaminated Granaries
entries.summary: The granaries are full, but the smell is wrong.

entries.name: Iconoclast Mobs
entries.summary: Public symbols become targets, and every faction calls the damage justice.

entries.name: Quarantine Breakdown
entries.summary: Disease policy becomes a test of obedience as much as medicine.

entries.name: Currency Rumors
entries.summary: Coins still shine, but trust does not.

entries.name: Provincial Secession
entries.summary: A province stops asking permission and begins collecting its own taxes.

entries.name: Veteran Coup
entries.summary: Those who defended the Empire now ask why they should not rule it.

entries.name: Industrial Poisoning
entries.summary: The engines that sustain the Empire begin to poison the people who built them.

entries.name: Scholars Disgraced
entries.summary: A failed prediction becomes a public scandal against learning itself.

entries.name: Sectarian Council
entries.summary: A holy dispute demands judgment from a government that survives by ambiguity.

entries.name: Citywide Petition
entries.summary: The people do not revolt; worse, they organize their demands coherently.

entries.name: Golden Pilgrimage
entries.summary: Pilgrims fill the roads, markets, shrines, and stories of the Empire.

entries.name: Scientific Breakthrough
entries.summary: For once, curiosity produces exactly what the Empire needs, at a price it notices later.

entries.name: Peace Embassy
entries.summary: A rival power chooses signatures over swords, but peace still needs concessions.

entries.name: Medical Doctrine
entries.summary: A disciplined theory of disease saves lives and offends older certainties.
